انقرضوا (form VII)
# اِنْقَرَضُوا (inqaraḍū) /in.qa.ra.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْقَرَضَ (inqaraḍa)
# اِنْقَرِضُوا (inqariḍū) /in.qa.ri.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْقَرَضَ (inqaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
